name: khroskyabs de Wobzi
confidence_why: 2 independent first-hand descriptions agree (1 state the same rule, 0 refine it); none contradicts.
catalog_citation: Lai, Yunfan. 2017. Grammaire du khroskyabs de Wobzi. Thèse de doctorat, Université Sorbonne Paris Cité (Paris 3), tel-01571916. PDF fromhttps://theses.hal.science/tel-01571916/document
catalog_quote: L’unité qui est sujette à porter un ton en khroskyabs de Wobzi est la syllabe. Nous distinguons deux tons. Un ton haut plat et un ton descendant. ... pour le ton haut plat, nous mettons un accent aigu sur la syllabe σ́; et pour le ton descendant, nous mettons un accent circonflexe sur la syllabe : σ̂ . ... Outre les deux types de syllabes tonales, nous avons en wobzi des syllabes atonales ... La syllabe atonale reçoit un ton bas L en forme de citation ... Nous définissons l’unité prosodique en khroskyabs de Wobzi une séquence de syllabes partageant au maximum un seul ton qui gouverne la totalité du sandhi tonal dans cette séquence. Ainsi, dans une unité prosodique, nous ne pouvons trouver soit qu’une syllabe porteuse de ton, soit aucune syllabe porteuse de ton, et la réalisation tonale des autres syllabes (si existantes) est assignée selon le ton de l’unité prosodique via le sandhi ton…

audit.reasoning: The record rests on the 791-page 2017 doctoral reference grammar by the language's principal describer, held locally (PDF + text), and every quoted fragment was confirmed verbatim at the cited sections/pages (2.4.1.1 p.108, p.109, 2.4.2.1 p.111, 2.4.3 p.114, 2.4.6.2 pp.126-127). The source has a dedicated tonology section with F0 evidence; it describes a two-tone (H vs HL) system with at most one lexically placed tonal syllable per prosodic unit and no stress, matching classification tonal with qv 'tonal-OR-pitch accent' and word(+clitics) domain. No better or newer prosodic study exists per Glottolog, HAL and Crossref; the only open independent description (Taylor-Adams & Lhawa 2020, Siyuewu dialect) was downloaded to and confirms the analysis ('Only one syllable in each word carries tone', two tones, no stress mentioned). Remaining unheld grammar

sources.citation: Taylor-Adams, Allison & Yulha Lhawa. 2020. A Sketch Grammar of Siyuewu Khroskyabs. Himalayan Linguistics Archive 9, i-ii + 1-84. DOI 10.5070/H919246822.
sources.quote: 'There are two lexical tones in Khryoskabs, a level tone and a falling tone. ... Only one syllable in each word carries tone. In polysyllabic words, non-tone-bearing syllables exhibit some phonetic effects when the falling tone is on an initial syllable ... it is the contrast between contour (level vs. falling) that is meaningful in this two-tone system, rather than relative pitch. Other analysts (e.g. Lai) analyze both tones as being high in pitch.' (Siyuewu dialect of the same glottocode; no mention of stress.)
sources.note: Independent (non-Lai) description of a sister dialect under the same glottocode; its tone section (two tones, one tone-bearing syllable per word) corroborates the culminative two-tone coding. downloaded now.
